Here’s the complete 12-week plan summary starting Monday 2026-06-01, integrating strength (cycle-phased), intensified Phase 2, aerobic base, HIIT, plyometric/power, and nutrition. Weekly cadence and session types
- Strength: 3 days/week (Mon A, Wed B, Fri C). Phase 1 Weeks 1–4 foundation; Phase 2 Weeks 5–8 intensified; Phase 3 Weeks 9–12 peak/consolidate with deload Week 12.
- Aerobic base: 2–3 Z2 sessions/week building to 150–210 min/week by Weeks 8–11; very easy during flow D1–D3.
- HIIT: 1 day/week, 18–28 min, Sat preferred; skip on flow D1–D3.
- Plyometric/Power: 1 day/week, Tue preferred; skip/modify on flow D1–D3 (throws/swings only).
- Optional mobility/recovery: 1 easy session/week as needed.

Breathing/bracing
- Non-flow: controlled brace; submaximal breath holds allowed if comfortable (no maximal Valsalva).
- Flow D1–D3: no breath holds; inhale on eccentric, long exhale on concentric.

- Protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day; carbs 3–6 g/kg (higher on heavy days); fats 0.8–1.0 g/kg; hydration 30–40 ml/kg/day plus training fluids.
